defects.summary: Decision 2 asks that each Kimi row's note carry the version (2.1.1), but the version is only in measuredWith.version; deviation 58 records this with a reason, but it still departs from an explicit decision.

The repository fixture seeds src/.kimi-code/config.toml and src/AGENTS.md, but no assertion checks that the copy leaves them out, so the setup suggests a sanitisation check that the test does not make.

The private Scopes class and the StandIn composition are copied from AKimiConsultationScenarioTests into both new test classes (three copies in total) instead of being shared, for example through KimiFixture or PlayedKimi.
The SandboxVocabulary doc still says 'any of the six runtimes' now that kimi makes seven.
The S5.5 tests read the shim argv with the literals "--home" and "--cwd", but the S5.6.5 test in KimiConsultantTests uses AcpWords.HomeFlag.

The admitted Kimi rows show the shared unconfined caveat ('a shell is always there, and no flag removes it'), which is false for Kimi because the shim refuses every shell command; this follows the spec and is honestly recorded as deviation 56 and open question 7, but it is left unfixed.

summary: All twelve scenarios are present and pass, and the build, the format check and the generator check are green. The production change is small and matches the spec: the planner arm (Snapshot for disk, Scratch for none, no flags), the refusal of any Flags or Leading, the three rows and vectors, and the runtimes list. The tests exercise the real check and the real service flow with junction-first recorders, and the recorded deviations are mostly true. The remaining findings are minor: the version is not in the notes, one fixture is never asserted, test helpers are copied, and one doc comment is stale.
